body_markdown:
This release includes bug fixes and new features, including the brand-new Unlayer re-design with themes.


#


## Bug Fixes


-


AI: Failed to make content suggestions if it was too long


-


Typo in Social Tool buttons for email address


#


## Features


-


New Themes for Unlayer Editor


-


Custom Buttons in Text toolbar now support SVG


We're thrilled to announce an exciting update to the Unlayer editor! This update brings a user-friendly interface designed to enhance the creative flow for users. We have also added four themes.


The new editor comes with:


-


Intuitive Design


-


Better Typography


-


Effortless Navigation


-


Coloring Feature
